issues: 整页与卡群锁在同一层统一 scale 1→2.25，层间没有速度差，读作“背景放大”而不是 dolly-zoom 的空间拉伸
背景卡群位置随手摆放，互相叠压、还压到主体边缘，开场构图拥挤
所有层同一 blur，景深没有远近层次；单层硬阴影，主体“钉住感”弱
背景平底色无暗角与颗粒，推拉的压迫感只靠缩放
changes: 按真实 dolly-zoom 光学分层：机位后退 R 倍时各层缩放 R(1+δ)/(R+δ)——整页 δ=6 → 1.91x、卡群 δ=1.2 → 1.43x、贴身搜索条 δ=0.3 → 1.17x，越远膨胀越猛
卡群重排成围绕主体的六卡环（互不重叠、不压主体），主体身后加一条近景搜索条做速度参照
景深按深度渐浅：整页 blur 1→6px、卡群 0→2.6px、近景 0→0.8px；整页与卡群之间加同色空气薄雾（0.38→0.5）
主体与卡片改两层软影，主体 elevation 14→40 随进程加深；暗角 0.1→0.32 随推拉收紧 + 极弱颗粒
issuesEn: The page and card cluster share one layer with a uniform 1→2.25 scale, so there is no speed difference between layers; it reads as 'background zooms' rather than dolly-zoom spatial stretching
Background cards are placed ad hoc, overlapping each other and the subject's edges, so the opening composition is crowded
Every layer has the same blur, so depth of field has no near/far layering; a single hard shadow weakens the 'pinned subject' feel
The flat background has no vignette or grain, so the push-pull pressure comes from scaling alone
changesEn: Layers follow real dolly-zoom optics: when the camera pulls back R×, each layer scales by R(1+δ)/(R+δ) — page δ=6 → 1.91x, card ring δ=1.2 → 1.43x, close search bar δ=0.3 → 1.17x — so farther layers swell harder
Cards are rearranged into a six-card ring around the subject (no overlaps, clear of the subject), with a near search bar behind the subject as a speed reference
Depth of field shallows with depth: page blur 1→6px, ring 0→2.6px, near layer 0→0.8px; a same-colour atmospheric haze (0.38→0.5) sits between page and cards
Subject and cards use two-layer soft shadows, with the subject's elevation deepening 14→40; the vignette tightens 0.1→0.32 with the move, plus very light grain
